description: Exact effective formulas of the dark-sector analysis of dirac16complex (SPEC sections 8, 11) for the corrected primordial metric of 2026-10-16 (version 2), derived by Revision/dark_sector/dirac16complex/derive/derive_effective.py (sympy); every entry is a named check of reports/derivation-checks.json.
coordinates: the author's coordinates {x0, ..., x7}: x0 = hidden direction, z = 6 H x0 real, y = ln|sin z|/(6 H); x1, x2, x3 = 3-space (scale factor e^{a4}); x4 = time; x5, x6, x7 = the three exponentially DEFLATING extra times (time-like, scale factor e^{-a4} b4^{1/2} (sin^2 z)^{1/12}); the hidden direction carries e^{-a4} b4^{1/2} too
metric: diag(e^{-2 a4} b4 cot^2 z, e^{2 a4} (x3), -1, -e^{-2 a4} b4 (sin^2 z)^{1/6} (x3)) (Revision/SPEC.md section 1, version 2); b4 = b4(x4) > 0
observerScaleFactor: a = e^{a4} (3-space scale factor, no warp), normalised a = 1 at the chosen 'today' a4 = a4_today, i.e. a = e^{a4 - a4_today}; b4 does not enter it
beta: beta = d ln b4/d a4 = b4'/(a4' b4); the record's history a4 = H x4, b4 = e^{(4/3) H x4} has beta = 4/3 (a prescribed background: it needs the source exponentialHistory.authorWeights.historySource_kappaT_minus_Lam)

conservation.x4: d4 rho = -3 a4' (rho + p3) - h4 (rho + p0) - 3 h4 (rho + p_t), h4 = b4'/(2 b4) - a4'
conservation.integrated: dE/da4 = -3 P3 - (beta/2 - 1)(P0 + 3 Pt) (beta = 4/3: -3 P3 + Pt + P0/3), E = int rho sqrt|g| d^7x, P = int p sqrt|g| d^7x per unit coordinate volume (fixed occupations / exact solutions)

rho4.A_compact_coordinate_period: ASSUMPTION: the extra times and the hidden direction are compact with a fixed coordinate period; rho_4 = E/(proper 3-volume) ~ E e^{-3 a4}
rho4.B_per_unit_coordinate_volume: per unit coordinate volume of the extra times and the hidden direction; rho_4 ~ E e^{-3 a4}
rho4.C_per_unit_proper_7_volume: rho_4 = E/Vol_7 x (constant) ~ E e^{a4} b4^{-2}

wEff.definition: w_eff = -1 - (1/3) d ln rho_4/d ln a

ratios.wx0: P0/E (integrated; the x0 ratio, not the CPL w0)

condensate.w_ratio: w_c = lambda S/(2 m + lambda S)

flatModeLabelled.status: flat (warp-free) limit, used for the sign structure and the limits only
flatModeLabelled.q_p_rate: d ln q_p/d a4 = d ln l_p/d a4 = 1 - beta/2
flatModeLabelled.massive_w_eff_A: k^2/(3 (M^2 a^2 + k^2)) (l = q = 0: independent of b4)
flatModeLabelled.foldBand: eps = e^{-a4} |k| exactly (ks-theory.json): w_eff(A) = 1/3, w_eff(C) = 1/3 - (4 - 2 beta)/3

mixtures.w_eff: linear in (P3, Pt, P0) at fixed E: sum over the components

cpl.convention: w(a) = w0 + wa (1 - a); thawing wa < 0, freezing wa > 0 (the formula decides)
cpl.tangent: w0 = w(1), wa = -dw/da at a = 1 = -dw/da4 at a4 = a4_today

expansionInferred.einsteinMixed: G^x4_x0 = 0 identically (the corrected metric has no mixed component)

recordHistory.status: a prescribed background; the Kohn-Sham gas is not its source
